description: Parses a user's natural language query and extracts structured fund search criteria including fund type, investment class, fund name, fund of funds flag, target audience, manager type, and other filters.

query.description: The user's natural language query about funds, e.g., 'find FIP funds' or 'show me funds with BTG in the name' or 'exclusive fund for qualified investors'.

fund_legal_name.description: Legal name of the fund (only if user explicitly mentions it).

fund_type.description: Fund type: FI, FIP, FIDC, FII, etc.

investment_class.description: Investment class: Multimercado, Ações, Renda Fixa, Cambial, FIP, Dívida Externa, Imobiliário.

fund_of_funds.description: Whether to filter for fund of funds (only if user explicitly specifies).

target_audience.description: Target audience for the fund (only if user explicitly specifies).

manager_type.description: Fund manager type (only if user explicitly specifies).

is_exclusive_fund.description: Whether to filter for exclusive funds (only if user explicitly specifies).

can_invest_abroad_100_pct.description: Whether fund can invest 100% abroad (only if user explicitly specifies).

has_long_term_taxation.description: Whether fund has long-term taxation benefits (only if user explicitly specifies).
